title: Billing Efficiency shows the exact percentage and equals Advisor Analysis
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in a fresh test location made for this run, so nothing else is invoiced, credited or clocked there; on the Dashboard, the Billing Efficiency tile on This Week shows no percentage (a grey "-").
  3. You run the whole case on one day, and not on the last evening of the week, so every record you create stays inside This Week.
  4. A test customer with one contact and one asset that uses that contact (for example ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer 1, contact Dana Test, unit ZZ-101).
  5. Technician 1 is you (Admin ShopView, Time Clock on): in a fresh location you are the technician offered in Add Technician, and you clock time yourself.
  6. Advisor A: you (Admin ShopView); the Service Advisor in the work order's left panel shows your name by default.
  7. One invoiced work order (not sent, not paid), Service Advisor Advisor A, two labor lines at $100.00 an hour: ZZAUTOTEST Line 1 with Estimated Time 2.00 and Tech Time 2.00, ZZAUTOTEST Line 2 with Estimated Time 1.50 and Tech Time 1.50, both for Technician 1, with exactly 3.00 hours clocked in total.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: create a fresh location for every run (use a new name each time, for example ZZAUTOTEST Quiet plus today's date and a letter): profile icon > Settings > Locations > New Location: Name, Address 1, City, State/Province, ZIP/Postal Code, Timezone, Telephone, Shop Supplies Charge 0 > Save & Close. Switch to it: click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. While you are in it, add the labor rate this test uses (rates belong to each location): profile icon > Settings > Labor Rates > New Labor Rate: Name (for example ZZAUTOTEST Rate 100, Rate 100) > Save & Close. Check: Dashboard > Billing Efficiency tile > range pill > This Week: it shows no percentage (a grey "-").
  • For 4: Customers > New Customer > Name > Save; on its Contacts tab: New Contact; add an asset (Add beside Asset in the New Work Order window, or the customer's Assets tab) and pick that contact in the asset's Contact field.
  • For 5: nothing to set up. To clock time: on the line's Labor row click Start, then Stop > Clock Out (same browser).
  • For 6: the Service Advisor is in the work order's left panel; pick another name there for a second advisor.
  • For 7: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); set Service Advisor to Advisor A in the left panel; in the New Line window (> New Line on the Lines tab for each further line): Add Technician Technician 1, Labor Rate the $100 rate you added in this location (for example ZZAUTOTEST Rate 100); Line 1 Estimated Time 2 and Tech Time 2; Line 2 Estimated Time 1.5 and Tech Time 1.5, tick Line Approved > Save & Close; as Technician 1 (yourself): on the line's Labor row click Start, then Stop > Clock Out; as Admin make the clocked time exactly 3.00 hours: three dots at the top right of the Lines tab > Timesheets (1) > edit the record (if it cannot be edited there or in Reports > Timesheet Activities, keep the real time and use the hours Timesheet Activities shows in every sum); on the line click Story (Add tech story for this line) > type a short story > Update; click Complete (if a Missing Details window asks for Mileage, enter one > Complete All Lines); click Mark Reviewed; Finance tab > Create Invoice; close the New Customer Payment window without paying (do not send or pay the invoice).
custom_steps:
1. Work out Billing Efficiency by hand: invoiced hours / clocked hours x 100 = (2.00 + 1.50) / 3.00 x 100 = 3.50 / 3.00 x 100 = 116.666..., shown as 116.67%.
  2. Click Dashboard in the top menu.
  3. On the Billing Efficiency tile click the range pill and choose This Week.
  4. Write down the percentage and the line under it.
  5. Click the arrow icon beside "Billing Efficiency" on the tile (its tooltip names the report).
  6. On Service Advisor Analysis make sure the Date control shows This week and no advisor is chosen in the Advisor filter.
  7. Write down your invoice's Hrs Worked, Hrs Invoiced and Billing Efficiency, and the Billing Efficiency in the Totals row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The tile reads 116.67%, to two decimal places (3.50 / 3.00 x 100 = 116.666... rounded).
  • The line under it reads "3.50 Invoiced / 3.00 Clocked".
  • The report row for your invoice shows Hrs Worked 3.00 and Hrs Invoiced 3.50. If Hrs Invoiced is not 3.50, mark the case Blocked and write down which line hours the report used.
  • The Totals row Billing Efficiency on Service Advisor Analysis reads 116.67%, the same as the tile.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9575 (S3), story SV-9576 (S4); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, S3 (S3-R1, S3-R2 Billing Efficiency row, context note), S4 (S4-R4, S4-R5). Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, captured 2026-09-28) used for on-screen labels and navigation only: boards 02_Last12_After, 05_Billing_After, 11_service-advisor-analysis_After.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R2: “Each measure is calculated as defined in the table below.”
  • S3-R2 table row (Billing Efficiency): “| Billing Efficiency | Invoiced hours divided by worked hours, times 100, for the selected range. | Service Advisor Analysis report |”
  • S4-R4: “The Billing Efficiency tile headline is the billing efficiency percentage for the selected range, shown to two decimal places.”
  • S4-R5: “The Billing Efficiency tile shows a supporting line reading "{invoiced hours} Invoiced / {clocked hours} Clocked".”
  • S3-R1: “Every figure the dashboard shows for a measure equals the figure the measure's matching report shows for the same workplace, date range, and filters. This holds at every moment, not merely in principle. The dashboard may serve a figure from a cache, but only in a way that cannot produce a difference: the tile and its report must resolve to the same stored calculation, or the cache must be invalidated by the same events that change the report's answer. A tile that shows a different number from its report because one of them is more recently computed than the other is a defect, not an accepted staleness window. There is no freshness allowance and no "up to N minutes behind" in this spec.”
  • S3 context note (parity check): “to check parity on a KPI tile that shows a shop-wide figure, compare it against the matching report with all advisors or all technicians selected (no filter applied).”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
